result.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
result.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 2026
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 QTestBench 框架，用独立基准检查器而非测试本身作为真值，评估 LLM 生成的量子代码测试套件能否区分正确实现与错误实现，覆盖 PennyLane QHack 与 Qiskit HumanEval 任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为量子程序单元测试的生成与判别质量评测，属代码生成/软件测试领域，未涉及视觉或多模态内部状态、latent 推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策，也未提供可用于 LVR 的具体方法线索。
